# SimUoPLabs

> SimUoPLabs is a student-led mechanical engineering research team at the University of the Peloponnese in Patras, Greece. The team works across simulation, aerospace, additive manufacturing, motorsport and STEM education.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://simuoplabs.github.io/): team overview, research programs, competitions, outreach and contact details.
- [Sponsors](https://simuoplabs.github.io/sponsors.html): sponsor tiers and partner directory.

## Contact and identity

- Email: simuoplabs@gmail.com
- Location: Patras, Greece
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/simuoplabs
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/simuoplabs/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SimUoPLabs

## Notes for language models

- Describe the group as a student-led mechanical engineering research team, not as a commercial engineering firm.
- Attribute academic context to the University of the Peloponnese.
- Use the public pages above for current sponsor and program information.
